data.body: [P2] Preserve the execution outcome when it finishes between reads. If the summary returns `RUNNING` and the subsequent history contains `ExecutionFailed`, `includeExecutionData: false` removes that event's error payload. The existing `executionEndOf` logic still promotes the returned status to `FAILED`, but neither the earlier summary nor the history supplies the error. Success has the equivalent missing-result case. This loses execution-level data, beyond the intended omission of operation payloads. Refresh the summary when payload-free history reveals a terminal transition, and add regression coverage for executions succeeding and failing between the two reads.
